mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a comfortable temperature of 74 degrees out by the Military Ridge State Trail, perfect for enjoying the view of the Full Moon this evening.

City Hall is busy with important updates. Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September as both Hunger Action Month and Suicide Prevention Month, while also designating today as Building Inspector and Code Staff Appreciation Day to thank our local safety guardians.
We have a packed schedule starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today. Looking ahead, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon and the Girls Try Hockey event are both set for tomorrow.
In our weekly police report, on August 17, officers responded to the 500 block of Cross Country Road where they arrested a 21-year-old man for a probation violation.
Stop by for a treat because today's flavor is Mint Explosion, and the store remains open until 10:30 PM tonight.
